svg.title: House painter — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as house painter, wearing coveralls and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A paint roller on a bent wire frame is accompanied by a small cylindrical paint tin. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
